summary: OrcaRouter CLI ships a focused OpenAI-compatible command surface (doctor, models, models get, chat, auth, auth set) rather than a full introspection API mirror, because the gateway exposes its OpenAI-compatible inference surface plus a model catalog — not the OpenRouter-style credits/providers/usage introspection API.
reason: A regen must not invent OpenRouter-style introspection commands (credits, providers, usage) that the OrcaRouter gateway does not expose; those endpoints return 404. The CLI is a named-provider gateway client, not a full API dump.
validated_outcome: Live probes confirmed /credits, /usage, /key, /providers return 404 on api.orcarouter.ai/v1; /models and /chat/completions return 200.
